set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- payload]
#[output application/java --- []]
set-variable.doc:name: outcomes = []

os:store.doc:name: Lock (fail if present)
os:store.os:value: #[output application/json --- { triggeredBy: vars.triggeredBy, since: now() as String, correlationId: correlationId }]

raise-error.description: Another report run is in progress; duplicate run rejected (NS 5). Try again when it finishes.

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { path: '/control/' ++ p('report.type') ++ '/' ++ p('report.entityCode') }]
set-variable.doc:name: call control

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import pendingPeriods, nowIst from dwl::report output application/java --- pendingPeriods(payload.lastReportedUpto, nowIst(), p('report.cutoffTime'), p('report.maxCatchUpPeriods') as Number)

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- [{ outcome: 'NOTHING_TO_REPORT', message: 'All closed periods are reported. Bookmark: ' ++ vars.bookmark ++ '. The next period closes at the ' ++ p('report.cutoffTime') ++ ' IST cutoff.' }]]

#[output application/java --- { severity: 'WARNING', alertType: 'MISSED_SCHEDULE', title: (sizeOf(vars.pending) as String) ++ ' reporting periods were not reported on time - catching up now', reportType: p('report.type'), entityCode: p('report.entityCode'), periodStart: vars.pending[0].periodStart, periodEnd: vars.pending[-1].periodEnd, details: 'Unreported business dates: ' ++ (vars.pending.reportDate joinBy ', ') ++ '. Each will be reported in order; the gap is recorded in the run history (triggered_by = ' ++ vars.triggeredBy ++ ').' }]
#[output application/java --- false]
set-variable.doc:name: stopCatchUp = false

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- payload]

set-variable.doc:name: issue options
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { isRevision: false, revisionOfRunId: null, flagMode: 'PENDING', advanceControl: true }]
#[output application/java --- vars.outcomes ++ [vars.outcome]]
set-variable.doc:name: add outcome

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- vars.outcomes ++ [vars.failure default { outcome: 'FAILED', errorMessage: error.description }]]
set-variable.doc:name: add failure

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- true]

raise-error.description: reportDate is required for a REVISION

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import revisionPeriod from dwl::report output application/java --- revisionPeriod(vars.request.reportDate as String, p('report.cutoffTime'))

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { path: '/control/' ++ p('report.type') ++ '/' ++ p('report.entityCode') }]
set-variable.doc:name: call control

when.expression: #[(payload.lastReportedUpto as LocalDateTime {format: 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'}) < (vars.period.periodEnd as LocalDateTime {format: 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'})]

raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'Business date ' ++ vars.period.reportDate ++ ' has not been reported yet - use mode NEXT, not REVISION']

set-variable.doc:name: call original
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { path: '/runs', query: { reportDate: vars.period.reportDate, status: 'SUCCESS', limit: 1 } }]

set-variable.doc:name: issue options
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { isRevision: true, revisionOfRunId: payload[0].runId default null, flagMode: 'ALL', advanceControl: false }]
#[output application/java --- [vars.outcome]]
#[output application/java --- [vars.failure default { outcome: 'FAILED', errorMessage: error.description }]]
#[output application/java --- { path: '/runs/' ++ vars.request.originalRunId }]
set-variable.doc:name: call run

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- payload]

raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'Run ' ++ vars.original.runId ++ ' did not issue a report (status ' ++ vars.original.runStatus ++ ')']

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var o = vars.original --- { entityCode: o.entityCode, entityName: p('report.entityName'), reportType: o.reportType, currency: p('report.currency'), reportDate: o.reportDate, periodStart: o.periodStart, periodEnd: o.periodEnd, sequenceNumber: o.sequenceNumber, isRevision: o.isRevision, generatedAt: o.startedAt }

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- [{ outcome: 'REPRODUCED', runId: vars.original.runId, reportDate: vars.ctx.reportDate, periodStart: vars.ctx.periodStart, periodEnd: vars.ctx.periodEnd, sequenceNumber: vars.ctx.sequenceNumber, isRevision: vars.ctx.isRevision, recordCount: vars.ctx.recordCount, fileName: vars.ctx.fileName, originalChecksum: vars.original.fileChecksum, regeneratedChecksum: vars.ctx.fileChecksum, identical: vars.original.fileChecksum == vars.ctx.fileChecksum, message: if (vars.original.fileChecksum == vars.ctx.fileChecksum) 'Regenerated file is byte-identical to the issued report' else 'Regenerated file DIFFERS from the issued report - investigate' }]]

logger.doc:name: Log reproduce
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'REPRODUCE runId=' ++ vars.original.runId ++ ' identical=' ++ (vars.outcomes[0].identical as String)]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- "RUN-" ++ ((now() >> "Asia/Kolkata") as String {format: "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"}) ++ "-" ++ (uuid() replace "-" with "")[0 to 5]

set-variable.doc:name: call create run
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { method: 'POST', path: '/runs', body: { runId: vars.runId, reportType: p('report.type'), entityCode: p('report.entityCode'), reportDate: vars.period.reportDate, periodStart: vars.period.periodStart, periodEnd: vars.period.periodEnd, isRevision: vars.issue.isRevision, revisionOfRunId: vars.issue.revisionOfRunId, triggeredBy: vars.triggeredBy, correlationId: correlationId } }]
#[output application/java --- payload]

logger.doc:name: Log start
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'RUN_STARTED runId=' ++ vars.runId ++ ' date=' ++ vars.period.reportDate ++ ' revision=' ++ (vars.issue.isRevision as String) ++ ' by=' ++ vars.triggeredBy]

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { path: '/sequences/next', query: { periodStart: vars.period.periodStart } }]
set-variable.doc:name: call sequence
report context
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { entityCode: p('report.entityCode'), entityName: p('report.entityName'), reportType: p('report.type'), currency: p('report.currency'), reportDate: vars.period.reportDate, periodStart: vars.period.periodStart, periodEnd: vars.period.periodEnd, sequenceNumber: payload.nextSequence, isRevision: vars.issue.isRevision, generatedAt: vars.run.startedAt }]

set-variable.doc:name: call finalize
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { method: 'POST', path: '/reports/finalize', body: { runId: vars.runId, reportType: vars.ctx.reportType, entityCode: vars.ctx.entityCode, periodStart: vars.ctx.periodStart, periodEnd: vars.ctx.periodEnd, sequenceNumber: vars.ctx.sequenceNumber, flagMode: vars.flagMode, expectedFlagUpdates: if (vars.flagMode == 'ALL') (vars.expected.pendingCount default 0) else vars.ctx.recordCount, advanceControl: vars.issue.advanceControl } }]

set-variable.doc:name: SUCCESS outcome
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { outcome: 'SUCCESS', runId: vars.runId, reportDate: vars.ctx.reportDate, periodStart: vars.ctx.periodStart, periodEnd: vars.ctx.periodEnd, sequenceNumber: vars.ctx.sequenceNumber, isRevision: vars.ctx.isRevision, recordCount: vars.ctx.recordCount, totalAmount: vars.ctx.totalAmount, customerCount: vars.ctx.customerCount, isNilReport: vars.ctx.isNil, fileName: vars.ctx.fileName, fileChecksum: vars.ctx.fileChecksum, chainHash: vars.chain.chainHash, deliveryMethod: vars.delivery.method, volumeDeviationPct: vars.deviation.pct, warnings: vars.ctx.warnings }]

logger.doc:name: Log success
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'RUN_SUCCESS runId=' ++ vars.runId ++ ' file=' ++ vars.ctx.fileName ++ ' records=' ++ (vars.ctx.recordCount as String)]

set-variable.doc:name: failure outcome
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { outcome: 'FAILED', runId: vars.runId, reportDate: vars.period.reportDate, periodStart: vars.period.periodStart, periodEnd: vars.period.periodEnd, errorCode: vars.errInfo.code, errorMessage: vars.errInfo.message }]

logger.doc:name: Log failure
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'RUN_FAILED runId=' ++ vars.runId ++ ' code=' ++ vars.errInfo.code ++ ' : ' ++ vars.errInfo.message]

set-variable.doc:name: call patch
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { method: 'PATCH', path: '/runs/' ++ vars.runId, body: { runStatus: 'FAILED', errorCode: vars.errInfo.code, errorMessage: vars.errInfo.message, completenessOk: vars.completeness.ok default false, completedAt: (now() >> 'Asia/Kolkata') as String {format: 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'} } }]

logger.doc:name: Patch failed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'Could not record FAILED status for ' ++ vars.runId ++ ': ' ++ (error.description default '')]

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { severity: 'CRITICAL', alertType: 'RUN_FAILED_' ++ vars.errInfo.code, title: 'Regulatory report for ' ++ vars.period.reportDate ++ ' was NOT issued', runId: vars.runId, reportType: p('report.type'), entityCode: p('report.entityCode'), periodStart: vars.period.periodStart, periodEnd: vars.period.periodEnd, details: vars.errInfo.message }]
